cases.sentence: Блаженны те, кто ходит по ___ Господа.
cases.explain: The preposition по (according to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Слово Твое сокрыл я в ___ моем.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Я буду славить тебя с честным ___.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Закон из твоих ___ лучше для меня.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from) governs the genitive case.
The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case with plural nouns.

cases.sentence: Не уклоняюсь от твоих ___, потому что ты учишь меня.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Блаженны те, чей путь непорочен, кто ходит по закону Господа.
reading.question: Who are described as blessed in this verse?
options: Those whose way is blameless and who walk by God's law
reading.correct: Those whose way is blameless and who walk by God's law
reading.explain: The opening of Psalm 118 defines the blessed as those whose path is blameless (чей путь непорочен) and who walk by God's law (кто ходит по закону Господа).

reading.ru: Слово Твое сокрыл я в сердце моем, чтобы не грешить против Тебя.
reading.question: Where has the psalmist hidden God's word, and why?
options: In his heart, so he won't sin against God
In his mind, to be wise
In his home, to protect it
In his writings, to remember it
reading.correct: In his heart, so he won't sin against God
reading.explain: The verse states он сокрыл слово в сердце моем, чтобы не грешить против Тебя — I have hidden your word in my heart so I won't sin against you.

reading.ru: Закон из твоих уст лучше для меня, чем множество золота и серебра.
reading.question: What does the psalmist value more than gold and silver?
reading.explain: The psalmist directly compares закон из твоих уст (the law from your mouth) to множество золота и серебра (vast amounts of gold and silver), saying the law is better.

reading.ru: Как может юноша содержать в чистоте свой путь, живя согласно слову твоему?
reading.question: How can a young man keep his way pure according to this verse?
options: By living according to God's word
reading.correct: By living according to God's word
reading.explain: The verse asks: как может юноша содержать в чистоте свой путь, живя согласно слову твоему? — How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

reading.ru: Я буду славить тебя с честным сердцем, обучаясь твоим праведным судам.
reading.question: How will the psalmist praise God?
options: With an honest heart, while learning God's righteous judgments
reading.correct: With an honest heart, while learning God's righteous judgments
reading.explain: The psalmist declares он будет славить с честным сердцем, обучаясь твоим праведным судам — he will praise with an upright heart, learning your righteous judgments.

reading.ru: Твои установления были моими песнями во время всех моих странствований.
reading.question: What role did God's statutes play for the psalmist?
options: They were his songs during all his wanderings
reading.correct: They were his songs during all his wanderings
reading.explain: The verse directly states твои установления были моими песнями во время всех моих странствований — your statutes have been my songs throughout my wanderings.
